Hi Alex — thanks, received everything. Quick acknowledgement and next steps from our side: 

1) Security intake: Irene (cc) will run the SOC 2 and subprocessor list through our checklist and flag any gaps. If we need the SOC 2 test-of-controls evidence we may ask for a scoped export; otherwise the public viewer link should be fine for initial acceptance.

2) PO routing: Ben in procurement (cc) manages PO issuance. Our standard PO format is Redwood-YYYY-NNNNN (e.g., Redwood-2027-04589); Ben, please confirm if you want HelixWare to include that pattern on invoices or if finance will map vendor-provided PO numbers.

3) DPA: Legal will perform a final pass; if there are no commercial redlines we can attach the DPA to the PO and proceed. Laura, I'll loop you in once procurement confirms the PO number.

Can you also surface your billing contact and the remit address for the invoice? If you have a preferred electronic invoicing system (Ariba/ Coupa/ email), flag it so we can route appropriately.

Irene, Ben — any immediate blockers I should relay? I want to avoid a second round of evidence requests.

Thanks,
Jordan
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
